Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens , LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). You will work cross-functionally with product, clinical, and engineering teams as we lead the future of AI in clinical care.

We prefer candidates who can work from our office in New York or Boston, but we are open to strong remote applicants. Our current mobile stack uses React Native and Expo and we have published apps on iOS and Android.

• Develop patient-facing features on our mobile app to enhance our AI-powered care delivery experience
• Build and lead a high-performing mobile engineering team to shape the future of our mobile app
• Scale mobile infrastructure with an emphasis on stability, performance, and data privacy
• Provide clear technical direction and sound decision-making frameworks to guide the evolution of our mobile platform

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in startups or fast-moving companies in mobile development

• Familiarity with cross-platform iOS and Android native development
• Experience scaling consumer mobile applications to serve hundreds of thousands of users

• You are a self-motivated, creative doer who takes ownership of broad initiatives and drives them to completion, navigating ambiguity with ease
• You have hands-on experience building from the ground up in fast-paced, high-growth environments, with experience at early-stage companies or through personal projects
• You thrive on working alongside exceptional teammates and derive energy from collaborative environments

What We Offer

• Impact: Be at the forefront and contribute to groundbreaking, AI-driven healthcare experiences, directly interface with execs at the world's leading tech & healthcare orgs
• Growth: Significant opportunities for broad ownership and professional development within our rapidly scaling startup
• Compensation: Competitive salary + equity
• Benefits: Comprehensive healthcare, vision + dental, 401K, Unlimited PTO, Parental Leave

Our Values

• Patients come first. We are clinicians 1st, technologists 2nd. We act with patient trust/safety at the center of every decision.
• Innovate with optimism. We are optimistic as we build the future of care delivery from first principles. Challenge the status quo when needed, no sacred cows.

Counsel’s mission is to multiply the world's healthcare capacity. We believe in a future in which every person has a personalized, AI-enabled doctor always in their pocket. To accomplish this, we’re building the first fully-vertical, AI-native medical group from the ground up. We’ve redesigned the entire clinical stack with custom AI tools that make our in-house physicians 10x faster and smarter. [learn more on our blog]

About On Me

Humans have given each other gifts since the dawn of time. For gratitude, for friendship, and for love. In today’s society, gifting has become harder and much more wasteful, as it’s become nearly impossible to know exactly what someone wants, when you just want to show that you care.

On Me is revolutionizing gifting by rebuilding it for the mobile and Instagram era. Traditional gift cards are impersonal and rigid, usually sold by an old and wealthy megacorp. We make it easy to send a personalized, media-rich gift that’s spendable across brands, fits someone’s hobbies, and drops straight into their mobile wallet for tap‑to‑pay. Check out our live experience at onme.com.

We’re a small startup from Google, Apple, and Stripe moving fast on a massive category and have raised $8M from top‑tier investors like NFX, Lerer Hippeau, Focal VC, and Mastercard. Since launching in November 2024, On Me has been featured in Tech Crunch, Fortune, and The Wall Street Journal. In 2025, we sustained over 40% growth month over month throughout the year, and the trend shows no sign of stopping.

In 2026, we're doubling down on making every gift feel magical end‑to‑end and building an amazing consumer product. You'll help us build world-class iOS and Android apps that people love.
